script_text: Stop everything, Aquarius—Uranus is about to crack open your hidden 12th House of secrets and solitude. Your ruling planet Uranus stations direct in Taurus while forming a sharp square to Mercury in Leo, activating your 8th House of shared resources, joint debts, and intimate bonds. This electric configuration clashes with your fixed Air nature, demanding sudden adaptation. If taken, expect a startling revelation about your partner's secret financial obligations or concealed debt. If single, an Air sign from your past resurfaces with a proposal that disrupts your usual emotional detachment. Jupiter in Cancer forms a flowing trine to your 10th House of career and public reputation, delivering a lucrative freelance offer through a professional network or group affiliation—read the contract twice before accepting. Avoid co-signing any loan today, no matter how urgent the plea from a close friend may seem. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
